agent_notes: No source found anywhere (web, news, gov, video, social, image, book/archive) that names 'Kankraliyo'/'कंकरालियो' or close spelling variants (Kankraliya/कंकरालिया, Kankralio) directly. Ran all 8 Tier-1 queries plus a wide Tier-2/3 sweep across channels (20 WebSearch calls, budget cap reached) and WebFetched 8 of the most promising pages. The census2011.co.in list of all 125 Lunkaransar-tehsil villages/towns does NOT contain Kankraliyo; the nearest-looking name is the unrelated village 'Kankarwala'. The 1972-era Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Bikaner) OCR text on archive.org also has no match. Several Patrika (Rajasthan) feature articles about the Mahajan Field Firing Range's 34-village displacement (2018, 2022 x2) were found and read in full; they name some of the other displaced/resettlement villages (Bhojrasar, Kumbhana, Motlai, Khanesar, Thohiya, Manera, Duder, Khajuwala, Dantor, Pugal, Mohangarh, Nachna) but never Kankraliyo, so none of these directly confirm the village. Given the task notes that this name comes from a single Facebook comment-list image with two blank positions, this strongly suggests 'Kankraliyo' needs independent verification -- it may be a hamlet/dhani never listed as a separate census revenue village, a misheard/misspelled name (possibly a corruption of 'Kankarwala', a real Lunkaransar-tehsil village, or of a differently-spelled 34-gaon village), or an error in the source image. Facebook/Instagram/YouTube searches for the village returned nothing usable via WebSearch (Facebook/Mapcarta/OSM pages returned 403 on WebFetch, so could not be read directly). Recommend a human check the original Bharat Speaks Facebook post/image directly and cross-check 'Kankarwala' as a possible spelling correction.
